title: Prescription sessions
lede: Every store's prescription sessions, read from HQ: the open ones, the orders not yet opened, and the ended ones.

denied.title: You don't hold the prescription-session list grant
denied.body: Reading HQ's prescription-session lists needs the PrescriptionSessionHq view grant. Ask an administrator to bind you to the HQ prescription-session role.

views.label: View
views.owedHint: Dispensed and not yet invoiced. Only the store filter applies.

filters.storeHint: Matches the holding store or the other store (a donor or an asking store).

columns.otherStoreHint: The donor store, or the store asking for a transfer

list.empty: No open session matches these filters.
list.failed: The prescription-session list could not be read.
list.truncated: Only the oldest-idle <n>{{shown}}</n> of <n>{{total}}</n> matching sessions are shown. The flag counts cover all of them.

toOpen.capped: Only the oldest <n>{{shown}}</n> of this store's <n>{{count}}</n> orders are listed: the list is capped across all stores, the count is exact.
toOpen.empty: No prescription order is waiting to be opened.
toOpen.failed: The orders waiting to be opened could not be read.

filters.storeHint: The store that held the session.

range.missing: Choose both dates of the range.
range.reversed: The range is reversed: the first date is after the last.
range.tooWide: A search covers at most <n>{{days}}</n> days. Narrow the range.

ended.empty: No session ended in this range.
ended.capped: Only the first <n>{{n}}</n> sessions to end in this range are shown. Narrow the range to see the rest.
ended.failedTitle: The ended sessions couldn't be read
ended.failed: The ended prescription sessions could not be read.
